Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray demonstrates thin vertical lucent streaks outlining the mediastinal structures (particularly along the left heart border and paratracheal region) and radiolucencies in the supraclavicular soft tissues indicative of subcutaneous emphysema, which are hallmark signs of spontaneous pneumomediastinum without underlying parenchymal lung disease or pleural effusion.
